products.name: Rajsi Virasat Choker
products.description:
A masterpiece inspired by royal Indian heirlooms, the Rajsi Virasat Choker is crafted to embody grandeur, heritage, and timeless elegance. Featuring layers of intricate antique gold artistry, deep ruby-toned stones, delicate kundan detailing, and a striking emerald drop centerpiece, this choker radiates regal sophistication.

The bold crescent motifs paired with handcrafted filigree textures create a majestic silhouette that beautifully frames the neckline. Perfect for bridal wear, festive occasions, and couture celebrations, this statement piece blends traditional craftsmanship with luxurious modern styling.

products.name: Ivory Royale Mandala Studs
products.description:
Delicately crafted with intricate filigree detailing, the Noor Mandala Stud Earrings blend timeless elegance with contemporary luxury. Featuring a floral mandala-inspired silhouette in radiant gold and silver tones, these statement studs are designed to capture light beautifully from every angle.

The lace-like texture and soft ivory accents create a refined aesthetic that pairs effortlessly with festive wear, bridal ensembles, and elegant evening looks. Lightweight yet striking, these earrings bring sophistication and grace to every occasion.
